description: Spread Merge Expander: adds another eight CV inputs and another CV output to a Spread Merge, and goes immediately to the right of it or of another of these expanders

params.text: Cycles how this expander's CV output is sampled: S&H takes the CV as the gate on the parent goes high and holds it, T&H follows that CV while the gate stays high

inputs.text: One of the eight CV inputs, sampled onto the channel the parent Spread Merge's gate at the same height is using

outputs.text: Carries the sampled CV of each input, on the same channels the parent's gate output uses

notes: the gates and the channel spreading are on the parent Spread Merge; this module has no gates of its own and its output stays at no channels until a Spread Merge is found to its left
a lamp at the top left glows yellow while a parent Spread Merge has been found, across any expanders in between
the CV inputs are monophonic; the output is polyphonic
